verdict.rationale: Hightouch documents a built-in agent that lets users explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language inside the product. AI Decisioning also uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing per customer, which covers both insights and suggestions drawn from the user's data. missing for 10: in-depth first-party docs on the built-in agent's insight capabilities (only a one-line mention), examples of proactive AI-generated suggestions surfaced in the UI, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: use the built-in agent to explore segments and analyze campaign performance in natural language
AI Decisioning uses reinforcement learning to recommend the best message, channel, and timing for each customer, then measures what worked.
Each agent combines everything a campaign needs to learn and improve: an audience, goals, messages, scheduling rules, and guardrails.
